Housing Developments

326 Rockaway

326 Rockaway is a new, 100% affordable rental building. The 14-story building includes 215 supportive and affordable apartments offered to a range of individuals. The unit mix reserves 130 units for formerly homeless families and young adults.

Building Details

  • 130 supportive housing units and 85 affordable units at or below 60% AMI
  • Approximately 8,000 square feet of community space at the cellar and ground levels
  • An art/reading room, children’s playroom, yoga space, gym, and bicycle storage
  • An outdoor recreation courtyard with seating areas, play structures, and landscaped green spaces
  • A community room, recreation room, and fifth-floor passive outdoor recreation space
  • Full-time security and maintenance staff, on-site social services, and a large laundry room
  • Passive House energy standards and solar panels

 

Neighborhood: East New York

Number of Units: 215

Status: Operating
